subject.title: fix(channels): honor configured read target policies

question: Should PR #99905 land as the broad fail-closed channel read authorization fix, including signed current-turn context and Google Chat reaction action removal?
rationale: The code path looks like the right security-boundary repair, but it changes compatibility-sensitive channel action behavior across several plugins and needs maintainer acceptance rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Land after green-gate refresh
options.body: Accept the stricter authorization behavior once exact-head CI is green and the Google Chat reaction no-op is considered an intentional compatibility note.

options.title: Require more upgrade proof
options.body: Hold merge until maintainers get explicit fresh-install and upgrade proof for representative Matrix/MSTeams/Feishu/Google Chat configs.

options.title: Split risky action-surface cleanup
options.body: Ask the author to separate Google Chat reaction action removal from the read-authorization hardening if maintainers want the security fix with less compatibility churn.

recommendation.title: Land after green-gate refresh
recommendation.body: Accept the stricter authorization behavior once exact-head CI is green and the Google Chat reaction no-op is considered an intentional compatibility note.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows broad ownership across plugin SDK/context and channel runtime boundaries touched by this PR.
